question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose queryInstructionTemplate as a memory-search config option and applyQueryInstructionTemplate as shared Plugin SDK surface, or should this policy remain provider-local?
rationale: The patch is no longer merely correcting a request payload: it adds user configuration and public plugin-facing API surface whose ownership and long-term model-policy contract cannot be safely chosen from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Approve shared opt-in contract
options.body: Keep the default-off config and shared SDK helper, with explicit ownership, compatibility documentation, and current-head upgrade/live proof.

options.title: Narrow to provider ownership
options.body: Remove the public helper and place the opt-in behavior behind the smallest provider-owned contract that satisfies bundled and generic OpenAI-compatible paths.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until maintainers decide whether OpenClaw should own model-id-specific retrieval templates at all.

recommendation.title: Approve shared opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off config and shared SDK helper, with explicit ownership, compatibility documentation, and current-head upgrade/live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work is most closely connected to the memory embedding provider and ownership boundary being expanded.
